Native reading supports colored text, backgrounds and font styles. For complex styles such as image bubbles or grids, use EPUB rendering.

Choose a local .red highlight rule file to import. Duplicate rules are skipped automatically; if a file can't be read, the reason is shown.

Global rules apply to every book; single-book rules bind to the book that was open at import time. If no book is open, you can bind one later from "Scope". Reeden book IDs are not used directly as local book IDs.

Rules stack in list order. Only body text is matched - the original text, bookmarks and read-aloud content are never modified. Title rules may leave the match content empty to target the whole title.

Only the RED01 format is supported. Some .red files use Reeden's AES encryption wrapper, which isn't supported yet - this doesn't mean you or the rule author set a password. Any Reeden font that isn't bundled falls back to the current reading font.
